description: An AI tool that extracts key terms, coverage limits, exclusions, deductibles, and premium costs from current policy documents and broker quotes into a structured comparison table.

An AI assistant that retrieves and summarizes key coverage gaps, claim patterns from claims history, and renewal risk factors (e.g., changes in asset base or prior claims) to highlight priority renewal topics for the finance team to discuss with brokers.

A classifier that evaluates return eligibility based on order history (purchase date, warranty status), product condition photos, and return policy rules, and recommends approve/deny/needs-review to the agent in real time.
A chat assistant that retrieves and summarizes relevant order history, warranty information, and policy excerpts for the agent in a single pane, without making the final return decision.

An AI tool that extracts transaction details (date, amount, description, reference) from bank statements and GL transaction records, standardizes them into a common schema, and surfaces them for automated matching.

A classifier that identifies likely matches between extracted GL transactions and bank statement transactions, and flags likely discrepancies (timing differences, reversed amounts, missing matches) for manual investigation.

An AI assistant that reads approved content calendar entries and platform-specific posting guidelines, then automatically drafts platform-ready posts (with hashtags, formatting, caption edits) for each channel, requiring only a final click-to-publish by the marketing user.

A classifier that reads approval sign-offs and content metadata, then tracks and flags posts as pending-approval, ready-to-schedule, scheduled, or published — surfacing bottlenecks and stalled approvals at a glance.

A classifier that reads incoming IT incident ticket descriptions and system logs, then assigns severity level (critical, high, medium, low) and auto-categorizes the ticket type (network, hardware, software, security, etc.) to standardize the triage process.

An extraction model that reads incoming ticket descriptions and cross-references them against historical incident data and system logs to detect duplicate or related incidents, then recommends merging or linking tickets.

An AI assistant that, after a ticket is classified and de-duplicated, recommends the right on-call engineer based on ticket category, the current on-call rotation schedule, the engineer's past ticket handling history, and ticket volume load, presenting the recommendation to a human dispatcher for final assignment.

An AI tool that classifies each sales transaction by region, product line, and applicable commission rule set, then flags transactions that fall into exception categories for manual review before calculation.

An AI tool that extracts commission-relevant fields (transaction date, amount, product category, rep territory, special terms) from unstructured sales notes and emails, and feeds them into the structured transaction log before classification.

An AI tool that ingests employment contracts, ID documents, right-to-work certificates, and tax forms from multiple submission channels (email, portal, file shares) and automatically extracts key fields (employee name, ID number, right-to-work status, tax classification, start date).

A classifier that checks extracted onboarding data against the compliance checklist and flags each new hire as 'ready-to-provision', 'missing-documents', or 'review-required', allowing HR to quickly route cases and prioritize follow-ups.

An AI tool that processes inspection checklists and free-text notes from safety inspectors, extracts structured data (hazard type, severity, location, corrective action required), and populates a standardized inspection database.

A classifier that tags inspection records with recurring hazard patterns (e.g., 'fall risk on scaffolding', 'improper PPE storage') by comparing new and historical inspection data, and flags sites with hazard clusters for priority follow-up.

An AI assistant that retrieves open corrective actions from the logs, matches them to new inspection findings, and alerts safety managers when a previously flagged hazard reappears or when a corrective action has not been completed within its target timeframe.
